name: Schnitt 5.6.0
notes:
## 3D camera tracking and stabilization

- New 3D panel for shapes, text, drawings, models and cameras.
- 4-point planar camera solve writes Location, Rotation and Tilt keyframes.
- Stabilize locks a clip against camera shake with a 2-point inverse track.
- Depth sorting switch and X/Y/Z, 3D rotation and scale controls with keyframe buttons.

## Expressions in keyframes

- Safe expression language for transform properties: time, t, frame, value, sin, cos, wiggle, noise, clamp, smoothstep, random and more.
- Expressions bake to ordinary keyframes, so preview, export and imported XML stay compatible.
- Source text is stored on the property and can be edited again.

## Adaptive preview and effects

- Adaptive preview reduces detail while playing and restores the chosen quality when paused.
- New Headbop effect with bounce, sway, tilt and squash properties.
- Deep Glow remains available, alongside the fixed Alight import effects.

## Import and export

- Keeps the 5.5.3 encoder fallbacks, software encoder support and best-effort verification.
- Keeps imported Alight names, values and keyframes while using corrected layer-size uniforms.
